name: agent-cross-check
description: When another coding agent (or a person) commits to your repo, Claude notices, runs mechanical checks (line endings, secrets, .env files) and audits the commits by diff and tests instead of trusting their report.

trustedMarker.title: Marker of your own commits
trustedMarker.description: Text in a commit message that marks it as made by this Claude, comma separated for several. Commits without it are treated as another agent's.

autoReview.title: Review automatically
autoReview.description: Ask Claude to audit new commits as soon as they appear (at most once an hour). Off: a notice above the prompt and /cross-check.

usageCeiling.title: Usage ceiling for automatic review (%)
usageCeiling.description: Automatic review waits while the 5-hour or weekly usage is at or above this percentage.

checkEveryMinutes.title: Check every (minutes)
checkEveryMinutes.description: How often to look for new commits while the session is open.
